title: Q-AUDIT-temporal-drift: fm-temporal-drift failing (fail): Take the open Q-TEMPORAL items for the finding; python3 -m foundation pathfinder --regress lists the commits since a loop last worked.
body:

**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failure_audit --probe temporal-drift
**Status:** closed

Failure mode `fm-temporal-drift` detected by `temporal-drift`, failing since 2026-11-21T13:41:18Z.
Evidence:  the 10 days before (10.0 a day)
repeated_failure ledger:executor:pr-outcome stood for 5 runs: pr-outcome: 1 failures in a row, 8 in the last 3 days against 0 in the 10 before
hotspot file:site/worker.js stood for 5 runs: site/worker.js edited 30 times in 3 days (outside generated and ledger paths)

Signature: f0f382958521 (disposition: fix).
Suspected root cause: a hotspot, neglected area, stopped loop or repeated failure stood in the series for several runs and nothing corrected it
Files the evidence names: `site/worker.js`
Remedy: Take the open Q-TEMPORAL items for the finding; python3 -m foundation pathfinder --regress lists the commits since a loop last worked.
Fix the earliest cause, so the detector passes; do not weaken or remove the detector.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failure_audit --probe temporal-drift

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-24T16:32:17Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 74.8 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
